gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: On registered held-out 328–331 across three tracks, the frozen candidate finished 11/12 versus 9/12 for the selected control. Finished-lap median was 22.36 versus 24.98 seconds; all eight common completed cells were faster for the candidate. The candidate's only nonfinish was track 3 seed 330 at reported progress 1.0 without valid finish crossing. This is local evidence, not an official score or release.
